snippet.title: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire | Official Boss Fight Reveal (Robo-Betty) - Convergence Showcase
snippet.description:
We are excited to share the official gameplay reveal for Robo-Betty, just one of the unique bosses that you will encounter while sleuthing through Mouseburg.

Cartoon weapons, devastating power-ups, and manic boss fights await in MOUSE: P.I. For Hire, launching on 19 March 2026. Wishlist now!
